criteria.description: Residual-only: an anomaly is emitted only when the event produced neither a Tier-1 nor a Tier-2 finding.
criteria.evidence: TestWiringTier1NoAnomaly, TestWiringTier2NoAnomaly, TestWiringStashGate (existing-failure branch), TestWiringPanicWithErrorTextDefersToTier2 (Go panic with 'runtime error:' -> Tier-2). analyzer.go stashAnomalyCandidates gates on len(Failures)==0.

criteria.description: No anomaly on bare generic words, narrative-channel content, codex-read/file-edit content, or artifact/spec events.
criteria.evidence: TestAnomalyResidualNegatives (bare words, Traceback), TestWiringNarrativeNoAnomaly, TestWiringStashGate (artifact kind -> none, H1), corpus seq7 narrative panic.
criteria.verified_by: kent (maintainer) via Claude orchestration + adversarial Codex review

criteria.description: Each anomaly carries provenance + a channel/tool/kind/token-normalized full-digest signature hash grouping identical shapes across files/runs.
criteria.evidence: TestSignatureHashGroupsSameShape (64-char, digit-normalized grouping), TestSignatureHashDistinguishesKindChannelTool, TestSignatureHashLongLinesDoNotCollide (full token, not bounded snippet), TestNormalizeTokenCollapses.
criteria.verified_by: kent (maintainer) via Claude orchestration + adversarial Codex review
criteria.notes: Hash uses full matched token; snippet bounded for evidence only (Codex WP01 fix).

criteria.description: An ignore registry of confirmed-benign signature hashes suppresses listed anomalies.

criteria.notes: Registry keys on the full digest.
